_about: Overnight Oct 17, Part 11: hand-written input for tools/npc_truth.js (merged into data/npcs/npcs.json): passing barks (one-liners an NPC says when the hero walks by), a short description, and species for NPCs the sheet leaves blank. Edit here and re-run the tool after an NPC import.

NPC-ELDER: Slow and steady. I invented that. The hare is still mad.
Back in my day, quests were uphill both ways.
NPC-GATEKEEPER: The road's open. My knees are not.
I guard a gate. The gate guards me. We have a system.
V-SABLE: Every card has a story, darling. Some of them even happened.
Psst. Shiny things, fair prices. Mostly fair.
V-TONIC: Potions! Charms! One tonic that is technically soup!
Hydrate or die-drate. That's my slogan. Workshopping it.
V-BEETSWORTH: Fact: bears can't climb the drawer. I checked.
Assistant TO the Regional Merchant. Say it right.
V-THREADWELL: You'd look great in a hat. Everyone would. Hats.
That cloak is giving 'main character'. Keep it.
V-FENWICK: Shiny packs! Fresh packs! Smell that cardboard!
I don't hoard. I curate. Loudly.
V-ALEMBIC: Do not touch the cauldron. Fine. Touch it a little.
Two essences walk into a cauldron. Only one walks out. Delicious.
NPC-BELLOWS: LADIES AND GENTLEMEN! Oh. Just you. Hi.
My voice has two settings: loud and arena.
NPC-HOB: Lovely day for it. For what? Oh, you know.
I dig graves. It's a hole lot of work.
NPC-BRONSON: Do you even lift, bro? I lift. Constantly. Help.
Rest day? Never heard of her.
NPC-GRAVOIS: The soup is the enemy. The soup is always the enemy.
Taste this. Don't. It tastes back.
NPC-MULLIGAN: Everything rots. That's the fun part.
One man's trash is another man's... also trash. Mine now.
NPC-PALLOR: Your application has been received. And rejected.
Please hold. Your afterlife is important to us.
V-BENCHLEY: Cards are like protein: more is more!
Nice form. On you, not the cards. The cards are fine.
NPC-HURL: Need a lift? I throw. That's a lift.
Landing is your problem. Throwing is my passion.
NPC-PUMP: Knowledge is power. Power is also power.
NPC-THUNDERABS: You came here to win. I came here to be loud. We both win.
Feel the burn! The sun, mostly.
NPC-MOUNTAIN: Up the mountain, there is wisdom. Also wind.
I have meditated for a hundred years. My left leg is asleep.
V-LEDGERBONE: Stamped, sealed, delivered... to the wrong department.
NPC-ECTOMUND: Questions? I'm the one who asks them.
Boo. That's the whole performance review.
NPC-KYLE: Is it still 2009 out there? No? Huh.
Rawr means I love you in dinosaur. I've been dead a while.
NPC-GERALD: Number four million two hundred and twelve. Any minute now.
The line moved! No. That was a draft.
NPC-AGNES: That book was due in 1847. I'm being patient.
Shh. This is a library. It's also a cemetery. Double shh.
V-MIREPOIX: Dessert first, darling. Always dessert first.
My dear, that deck needs more butter.
NPC-PATE: Life is like a terrine: layers, and nobody knows what's in it.
NPC-FLAMBE: Everything's better on fire! Most things! Some things.
NPC-BASIL: Have you seen my thyme? I'm running out of it.
V-GRISTLE: Compost is just future dinner, dearie.
Smells like progress. Or that's the bins.
NPC-THISTLEWICK: The forest is speaking. Mostly about you. Mostly nice.
Leaf me alone? Never. Too lonely.
NPC-RHONDA: That's not trash, that's a vintage.
NPC-BRAMBLE: Hedge your bets. Literally. I'm a hedgehog.
NPC-WREN: Keep your head down and your hope up.
V-FIGSLY: You didn't see me. I didn't see you. We're both very sneaky.
Rare cards, no questions, some answers.
NPC-KESTREL: Eyes up. Primm's watching. He's always watching. Rude.
I scout. You shout. Good team.
NPC-PELL: Everything is perfectly fine. Blink twice if it isn't.
The dead don't complain. That's what scares me.
NPC-ROLLO: Wheels go round. Kingdom goes round. Mostly.
Need a spoke? I've got loads.
NPC-MARLO: Underground cooking: all the heat, none of the sky.
NPC-FERN: Plant a seed, plant a hope, plant a gnome.
NPC-CITIZEN: Everything is perfect! Everything is perfect! Everything is—
NPC-ISLA: Dad says hi. Dad says a lot, actually.
The Capital's alive again. Loud, too. I like loud.
NPC-VILLAGER: I knead a vacation. Get it? Knead?
NPC-TOWNSFOLK: Lovely day for a quest, isn't it?
My cousin's a dragon. Long story. Mostly fire.
Did you hear the well talks now? It doesn't. But imagine.
I'm not lost. I'm exploring the same street on purpose.

descriptions.NPC-ELDER: Crosspath's tortoise elder and keeper of the Wanderer's lost memories.
descriptions.NPC-GATEKEEPER: The bear who guards the Capital road and hands out the kingdom's biggest quest.
descriptions.V-SABLE: A fox card dealer with a story for every card and a price for every story.
descriptions.V-TONIC: A frog apothecary selling potions, charms and occasionally soup.
descriptions.V-BEETSWORTH: The rule-bound equipment vendor who runs the level-5 armory quest.
descriptions.V-THREADWELL: A mouse tailor who believes everyone deserves a better hat.
descriptions.V-FENWICK: A magpie who sells sealed card packs and cannot resist anything shiny.
descriptions.V-ALEMBIC: An otherworldly alchemist who brews multi-Path cards from essence.
